postal_system.assignment_rule: Correos de Nicaragua defines five numeric digits: digit one is the geopostal region; digits two and three identify a municipality subject to departmental-capital and Managua-quadrant rules; the remaining digits identify an urban barrio or rural comarca, while official results may also be a municipality Código Maestro. A current official lookup observation, not syntax, a copied list or an administrative-code match, is assignment evidence.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Treat a full five-digit object as area-or-non-area. A barrio or comarca assignment may support a polygon candidate only after an exact, time-compatible and rights-cleared crosswalk. A Código Maestro, post office, P.O. box, organization, route or unknown object is not an area. No reusable national official postcode polygon release has been verified for this seed. Search pages, INETER boundaries, census units, road buffers, interpolation, Voronoi cells and model outputs remain official-context or derived-review geometry and cannot fill unknown coverage.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, traditional or directional reference, street, house number, building or residential name, floor, unit, barrio or comarca, locality or community, municipality, department or autonomous region, P.O. box, post office and five-digit postcode separately. UPU and operator examples are never production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as barrio_or_comarca, municipality_master, postal_area, locality, post_office, po_box, organization, route or unknown. A Código Maestro, barrio, comarca, municipality, postcode, delivery route and postal office must never be collapsed into one polygon class.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identifier, an explicit reviewed relation to a permitted building identifier, and separately permitted point or footprint geometry with producer, edition, validity, privacy, CRS and digest pinned. A postcode, directional reference, landmark, barrio, comarca, municipality, cadastral parcel, coordinate, containment, interpolation or proximity is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.administrative_rule: INIDE identifies fifteen departments, two autonomous Caribbean Coast regions and 153 municipalities. INETER exposes official national, departmental and municipal boundary services and base cartography. These are administrative and cartographic context, not Correos assignment or postal geometry; pin the exact edition, layer, maintenance state, CRS, terms and digest before crosswalking.
postal_system.cadastre_rule: INETER cadastral IDE and consultation services are restricted context. Published terms limit use and require authorization for reproduction or a substitute dataset. Parcel, survey, property, owner and licensed-user fields remain independently governed and cannot be inferred from a postcode or republished without authority.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Authorized Correos observations plus rights-cleared INIDE, INETER and road data may normalize input, validate strict joins, build candidate barrio-or-comarca review surfaces, compress geometry, create indexes, detect drift and train or run review models. Every output preserves service or release version, input and artifact digests, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, cache TTL, confidence, uncertainty and official-observation or derived-review status. It never overwrites evidence, converts Código Maestro into an area, fills unknown coverage or invents a directional reference, house number, civic address, unit, building, person, owner, occupant or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate time-bound Correos observations, typed postal objects, reviewed derived postal-area geometry, permitted civic addresses, explicit address-to-building relations and administrative or cadastral context to AGID cells without relabelling any source object as an AGID cell or claiming AGID geometry is official Nicaraguan postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Public Correos search access does not by itself grant bulk postcode, barrio, comarca or address redistribution rights; pin applicable automation, cache, privacy and reuse terms. UPU publications are standards references, not bulk-data licences. INIDE publications and each INETER service require item-level producer, edition and reuse review. INETER cadastral terms restrict purpose and reproduction. ODbL content remains separately attributed and partitioned.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The pack is ISO NI scope and stores national, geopostal-region, department, autonomous-region, municipality, Managua-quadrant, barrio, comarca, locality, community and source-specific coverage independently. Postal, administrative, cadastral, address, building and AGID coverage, asserted_by, legal status and vintage must not be conflated or extended beyond an artifact's declared jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, traditional directions, landmarks, house numbers, unit identifiers, coordinates, operator queries, cadastral records, owners, recipients, organizations, credentials and logs can expose household, property, security or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention, access control and publication review; exclude private, owner-linked and query data from public artifacts.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Correos assignments and observations, the May 2014 UPU sheet, INIDE territorial editions, INETER layers and terms, cadastral states, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, generated_at, service and artifact version, edition, digest and supersession independently.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: A Hugging Face Dataset may publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet or GeoParquet partitions with source release, item terms, schema, CRS, digest and provenance. Operator query logs, real addresses, directional references, cadastral or owner-linked data and restricted inputs stay private, gated or external. Dataset Viewer is discovery, a Space is demonstration, and production AGID readers pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
